svg.title: The exponential information curve and the standard-deviation floor it implies
svg.desc: Left panel: information per observation falls steeply as one over lambda squared. Right panel: the smallest achievable standard deviation for an unbiased estimator rises in a straight line proportional to lambda.
svg.text: Information depends on where you are in the parameter space
I of lambda equals one over lambda squared
a small rate is a long lifetime,
the floor is lambda over root forty
Neither panel mentions the recorded numbers. Both are properties of the model, computable before a single observation is taken.
The two effects cancel in relative terms. The floor divided by lambda is one over root n at every lambda, here 0.158.
